title: Add billing-ledger reconciliation export (Snowflake) + schema docs + access gating
author: Mei Lin
release_notes: Internal-only: introduces `FINANCE_RECON.BILLING_LEDGER_EXPORT_V1` for RevRec reconciliation and drift monitoring; gated to FINANCE_RECON_READER role. No customer-facing changes.
description:
Problem: Finance/RevRec needs a stable, auditable export table to reconcile billing ledger totals against usage events and customer usage exports. Today the process relies on ad-hoc queries across mutable upstream tables with inconsistent joins and unclear ownership, which increases close risk and slows dispute investigations.

What this PR does: Adds a first-class reconciliation export pipeline that materializes billing-ledger line items into a finance-owned Snowflake schema, with a documented schema contract and strict access gating. This export is designed for month-end close workflows and for automated drift checks (ledger vs usage events) without exposing sensitive per-request data.

Deliverables in this PR: (1) New export table: `FINANCE_RECON.BILLING_LEDGER_EXPORT_V1` (daily partitioned) containing invoice-period usage aggregates and the minimal dimensions required for reconciliation. (2) A scheduled job (hourly + end-of-day hardening run) that populates the export from the billing ledger source-of-truth while preserving an immutable snapshot per `billing_run_id`. (3) Schema documentation in-repo, including field definitions, nullability guarantees, and join keys to telemetry/usage events. (4) Access gating: write access limited to the metering pipeline service role; read access limited to `FINANCE_RECON_READER` (Finance/RevRec + explicitly approved RevOps users). (5) Guardrails: row-count and checksum assertions, and a canary query used by the metering sanity job to catch incomplete loads.

Schema highlights (v1): Primary grain is one row per (billing_run_id, account_id, usage_day, product, meter, model, region, price_plan_id). Core fields include `billed_tokens_prompt`, `billed_tokens_completion`, `billed_tokens_total`, `request_count_billed`, `embedding_units_billed`, `amount_usd`, `currency`, `invoice_id` (nullable until invoicing), `contract_id` (nullable), `dedupe_key_version`, `source_table_version`, `generated_at`, and `data_freshness_lag_seconds`. We deliberately exclude raw prompt text, user identifiers, and per-request IDs; where a join is needed for investigations, Finance can request temporary scoped access to the underlying ledger detail table via INT-932 workflow.

Operational notes: The export is append-only by `billing_run_id` (immutability), so backfills create a new billing run instead of mutating prior snapshots. The job supports a `--dry-run` mode that writes to `FINANCE_RECON._STAGING_BILLING_LEDGER_EXPORT_V1` for validation. Late-arriving ledger adjustments are captured via a new billing run and can be compared using `previous_billing_run_id`.

Access control: Adds a new Snowflake role `FINANCE_RECON_READER` and grants SELECT on the export table + schema usage. Grants are managed via `infra/snowflake/roles/finance_recon_reader.sql` and audited in the existing access-log sink. This aligns with the metering data retention/access policy and reduces the blast radius compared to granting direct access to ledger tables.

Testing: Includes dbt schema tests (not_null, accepted_values, unique key), unit tests for the transform mapping, and an end-to-end staging run validation query. CI runs the transform unit tests; dbt tests run in the data-ci environment.

Follow-ups (out of scope): Wire this export into the Console metering sanity dashboard drilldowns (ENG-4415) and use it as the canonical input for the month-end checklist automation. Also pending: add `cache_hit_billed_tokens` once PR-27485 lands and we confirm the finance reconciliation joins.

Risk: Low. Internal-only pipeline + gated table. No changes to metering logic or invoice generation in this PR.

Docs/links: Confluence reconciliation playbook will link to this schema doc after merge; owners are Finance (Emily Stone) + Eng Telemetry (Mei Lin).

pipeline: add scheduled export job + dry-run/staging target
security: introduce FINANCE_RECON_READER role and grants
tests: add dbt schema tests + transform unit tests
docs: add reconciliation export schema contract + usage examples
review_conversation:
Logan Wright: Can we guarantee immutability for month-end audits? I don’t want Finance querying a table that silently changes.

Mei Lin (author): Yes — the export is append-only keyed by billing_run_id. We never UPDATE prior runs; backfills create a new run with `previous_billing_run_id` pointing back. Added that explicitly to the doc + a unit test to fail if the job attempts to update existing billing_run_id.

Caleb Johnson: The job currently runs hourly. What’s the expected freshness SLA and what happens if it falls behind?

Mei Lin (author): Added `data_freshness_lag_seconds` and a simple canary query that computes lag from ledger ingestion watermark. This will be wired into the sanity job/alerts; for now it logs WARN > 2h. Aisha is adding alerting thresholds in the metering dashboard PR.

Emily Stone: Please confirm the export excludes any fields that could be considered customer content or personal data. Also need a clear list of who can access it.

Mei Lin (author): Confirmed: no prompt/response text, no end-user identifiers, no request_ids. Added a “Data classification” section to docs and updated grants to only FINANCE_RECON_READER. Access requests go through INT-932 and are audit-logged.

Aisha Bello: The assertions query should check both row counts and amount_usd checksum to catch partial loads.

Mei Lin (author): Done — added `sum(amount_usd)` vs ledger watermark window plus a per-day row-count floor. Both checks run in the staging validation and in CI (data-ci).

Logan Wright: Looks good. Please add a short section describing how to join to usage events for drift checks.

Mei Lin (author): Added join keys + example queries (by account/day/model/region) and caveats about meter_version changes.

Approvals: Logan Wright approved. Caleb Johnson approved. Emily Stone approved (Finance sign-off). Aisha Bello approved.
merge_outcome: Merged to main; squash commit `7f3c9b1`. Deployed with next scheduled pipeline rollout; role grants applied via infra apply 2026-02-17 18:20 PT.
